hahaha.definition:
To express on AIM when something was funny, because just 'haha' isn't that dramatic and can be used as just aknowledging when someone has said something.
> Bobby31: ...they call it cheese and quackers!
> Annette85: haha
> Bobby31: oh come on it was funnier than that
> Annette85: hahaha

hahas.translation: (haha 的复数) n. 哈哈（笑）

hahn.definition: n. German chemist who was co-discoverer with Lise Meitner of nuclear fission (1879-1968)

hahn oxine reagent.translation: [医] 哈恩氏8-羟基氮萘试剂

hahn's cannula.translation: [医] 哈恩氏插管(围以压缩海绵的插管)

hahn's operation.translation: [医] 哈恩氏手术(胃切开治贲门或幽门狭窄)

hahn's sign.translation: [医] 哈恩氏征(儿童小脑病变时,头部持续性向两侧转动)

hahnemannian.translation: a. (德国医师)哈内曼的, 哈内曼疗法的

interj. Same as Ha.
